whatHappened: The lead submitted a Facebook form and signed with another agency the next day because that agency called back the same day. Our first recorded outreach came about 53 hours after the form.
primaryFailure: Slow first response: a competitor reached the lead first.
primaryFailureEvidence: Note: first outreach call about 53 hours after the form. Lead said she already signed with another agency because they called her back the same day.
secondaryFailure: No owner was assigned, so nobody was accountable for the first call.
missingDataThatWouldHelp: Exact time the lead reached the CRM
Any automated acknowledgement sent to the lead
recommendedFix: Auto-assign inbound leads on creation and enforce a 15-minute first-call task with escalation if it is missed.
